# Current Projects

Our laboratory is engaged in interdisciplinary research focusing on plant–microbiome interactions and sustainable agriculture.

## Ongoing Research Projects

### 🌱 Rhizosphere Microbiome of Wild *Allium* Species
Characterization of microbial diversity and functional potential associated with wild *Allium* species using high-throughput sequencing and bioinformatics.

### 🧬 Plant–Microbe Interactions
Understanding beneficial interactions between plants and microorganisms to improve crop health and productivity.

### 🦠 Synthetic Microbial Communities (SynComs)
Development of microbial consortia for enhancing plant growth, nutrient uptake, and disease resistance.

### 🌾 Sustainable Agriculture
Exploring eco-friendly approaches for improving crop productivity through microbiome engineering.

### 🧅 Biofertilizer–Microbiome Interactions
Investigating the impact of biofertilizers on soil microbial communities and crop performance.
